lines.trans: Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who writes to Courtyard Inn from abroad?
Listen to this: "Dear courtyard friends, thirty years ago this May I stayed in Room Eight!"
Thirty years ago this May—that exact rainy week! Read the rest, Qing.
"I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my wet maps."
Room Eight! Let me check my aunt's green guest book—yes, the mapmaker is right here!
Keep listening: "Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule."

words.gloss: set out on a long journey

lines.trans: A time capsule?! In my own courtyard?!
Does the mapmaker say where they hid it, Qing?
"If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat stones north from the old tree!"
Three flat stones north from the tree?! That is right under table number one!
Hold on—when I levelled table one at dusk, that third stone sounded hollow!
Grab the lantern, gentlemen—Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià cì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 下一次 ('the next occasion').

examples.text: 下次来成都，一定再来住我们客栈！
examples.trans: Next time you come to Chengdu, be sure to stay at our inn again!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，我们下次见！
examples.trans: It was lovely chatting today—see you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Adjective qīn'ài ('dear').

examples.text: 亲爱的同事们，大家辛苦了。
examples.trans: Dear colleagues, thank you all for your hard work.

examples.text: 她给亲爱的家人打了个电话。
examples.trans: She called her dear family.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Third-person plural pronoun for male or mixed groups.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: men. Attaches to pronouns (我们, 你们, 他们) and human nouns (孩子们).

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封信 ('a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng wǎn. Combines 傍 ('draw near to') + 晚 ('evening'): the golden hour around sunset.

examples.text: 傍晚的时候，院子里的灯笼一盏接一盏亮了。
examples.trans: At dusk, the lanterns in the courtyard lit up one after another.

examples.text: 夏天的傍晚最适合坐在院子里乘凉。
examples.trans: Summer evenings at dusk are perfect for sitting in the courtyard to enjoy the breeze.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

出远门.gloss: set out on a long journey; travel far from home

meanings.en: set out on a long journey; travel far from home
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū yuǎn mén. Separable verb-object compound 出 ('go out of') + 远门 ('distant gate / long trip').

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before setting out on my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 老陈每次出远门以前，都会把工具抽屉整理得干干净净。
examples.trans: Before going away on any long trip, Chen always tidies his tool drawer spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú yuán. Combines 制图 ('make maps/charts') + occupational suffix 员 ('person/specialist'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 名 (míng).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 这位细心的制图员用钢笔在厚纸上画出了整条老街。
examples.trans: This careful mapmaker drew the entire old lane on heavy paper with a fountain pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běi. Direction noun; combines with 往 ('toward') as 往北 ('northward') or 边 as 北边 ('the north side').

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 阳光房朝南的窗户最亮，北边的木墙正好放书架。
examples.trans: The south-facing windows of the sunroom are brightest, while the north wooden wall is ideal for bookshelves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí jiā. Verb-object compound 回 ('return') + 家 ('home'); takes no location particle between them.

examples.text: 买完菜以后，我们一起走路回家吧。
examples.trans: After finishing the grocery shopping, let's walk home together.

examples.text: 下班回家的路上，我买了一束鲜花。
examples.trans: On my way home from work, I bought a bunch of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Outside one's home country.

examples.text: 他女儿目前跟着家人在国外读书。
examples.trans: His daughter is currently studying abroad with family.

examples.text: 这档节目专门去国外几个城市取景拍摄。
examples.trans: This show filmed on location across several cities abroad.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn. Verb meaning to place a pillow, pad, or mat underneath something to raise or cushion it (垫着靠垫 'propped on a cushion').

examples.text: 小美在厨房门口垫着软靠垫，自豪地看完了全过程。
examples.trans: Propped on a soft cushion at the kitchen doorway, Mei proudly watched the whole process.

examples.text: 热汤锅端上木桌以前，记得先在下面垫一块厚竹垫。
examples.trans: Before setting the hot soup pot on the wooden table, remember to put a thick bamboo mat underneath.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场大雨 ('a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 外面的大雨下了整整一个晚上。
examples.trans: The heavy downpour outside lasted the entire night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rú guǒ. Standard conditional conjunction ('if'), often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 如果你同意，我想把这首曲子补写完整。
examples.trans: If you agree, I would like to finish writing this piece of music.

examples.text: 如果明天不下雨，我们就把桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will move the tables out into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Used as a stative adjective ('flat/level') or resultative complement after verbs (收平 'fold flat', 铺平 'smooth flat').

examples.text: 把折叠椅收平以后，就能靠墙放好了。
examples.trans: Once you fold the chair flat, you can lean it neatly against the wall.

examples.text: 院子中间的石板路铺得很平。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the middle of the courtyard is laid very flat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: In one's youth.

examples.text: 团队里有很多充满活力的年轻编导。
examples.trans: The team has many energetic young writer-directors.

examples.text: 年轻的时候多经历一些挫折其实是好事。
examples.trans: Facing a few setbacks while young is actually a good thing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

开张.gloss: open for business; hold a grand opening

meanings.en: open for business; hold a grand opening
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi zhāng. Separable verb-object compound 开 ('open') + 张 ('spread/set up shop'), the classic word for a shop or café opening.

examples.text: 两位先生，快提上灯笼——九号房开张了，下一个谜团就在树底下！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern, gentlemen—Room Nine is open for business, and our next mystery starts under the tree!

examples.text: 星期五傍晚六点，我们的小院咖啡馆正式开张。
examples.trans: At six o'clock on Friday evening, our courtyard café officially opens for business.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

接着.gloss: continuing on, right after that, keep on

meanings.en: continuing on, right after that, keep on
meanings.note: Adverb before a verb meaning carry right on doing.

examples.text: 喝口热茶歇五分钟，咱们再接着对台本。
examples.trans: Have some hot tea for five minutes, then let us keep going over the script.

examples.text: 主持人念完感谢名单，接着宣布了最终冠军。
examples.trans: After reading the credits, the host went on to announce the champion.

meanings.en: lift up; carry (by a handle); mention
meanings.note: Pinyin: tí. Used for lifting a door handle or carrying a bag by its strap/handle.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Used for saving a historic building or rescuing breakfast.

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 呼，好在反应快，早餐又有救了！
examples.trans: Phew, quick thinking saves breakfast once again!

meanings.note: Noun shù ('count; certainty in 心里有数').

examples.text: 你以为雷总心里一点数都没有吗？
examples.trans: Do you think Director Lei has no idea what goes on?

examples.text: 经费还剩多少，我心里有数。
examples.trans: I have a clear count of how much budget remains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo. Used for knocking on doors or pipes clanking.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān jiāo náng. Compound 时间 ('time') + 胶囊 ('capsule'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 出远门回家以前，我和您姑姑藏了一个小铁盒时间胶囊。
examples.trans: Before my long journey home, your aunt and I hid a small tin time capsule.

examples.text: 时间胶囊里装着三十年前的手绘地图和一张旧照片。
examples.trans: Inside the time capsule were a thirty-year-old hand-drawn map and an old photograph.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

有一天.gloss: one day; someday (in the future or past)

meanings.en: one day; someday (in the future or past)
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu yì tiān. Fixed time expression 有 ('there is/was') + 一天 ('one day', with yī -> yì before 1st-tone tiān).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine one day, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 她一直相信，有一天这首圆舞曲会在阳光房里重新响起。
examples.trans: She always believed that one day this waltz would ring out again in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Reduplicated casual form of 查.

examples.text: 请帮我在人事系统里查查这项任命的登记信息。
examples.trans: Please check the HR system for the registration of this appointment.

examples.text: 播出前再仔细查查字幕里有没有错别字。
examples.trans: Double-check the subtitles for typos one more time before air.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

淋湿.gloss: get drenched by rain; soak through

meanings.en: get drenched by rain; soak through
meanings.note: Pinyin: lín shī. Resultative verb compound 淋 ('drench/pour upon') + 湿 ('wet').

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 快进屋喝杯姜茶吧，你的外套都被雨水淋湿了。
examples.trans: Come inside for a cup of ginger tea—your coat has been soaked by the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng jì běn. Compound 登记 ('register / check in') + 本 ('bound book'). Measure word: 本 (běn).

examples.text: 每一位住店的客人都要在前台登记本上签字。
examples.trans: Every guest staying at the inn signs the register book at the front desk.

examples.text: 阁楼木箱里保存着三十年前的绿色客人登记本。
examples.trans: A green guest register from thirty years ago is preserved in the attic wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Single-character bound/free noun for small boxes (木盒 'wooden box', 盒子 'box'); also a measure word ('a box of').

examples.text: 雪松木盒里整齐地放着一叠旧明信片。
examples.trans: A stack of old postcards sits neatly inside the cedar box.

examples.text: 小晴买了一盒彩色粉笔写咖啡馆黑板。
examples.trans: Qing bought a box of coloured chalk to write on the café blackboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn. Combines 石 ('stone') + 板 ('slab/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 雨后的院子石板路干干净净，映着温暖的灯光。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard flagstone path is spotless and reflects the warm lamplight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng. Describes an unoccupied room or bare floor.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Ordinal numeral dìsān ('third').

examples.text: 接下来介绍第三季的全面改版计划。
examples.trans: Next we present the full overhaul plan for Season Three.

examples.text: 今晚的第三位竞演歌手即将登台演唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's third competing singer is about to take the stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì xù. Followed directly by another verb or used alone.

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 喝口热茶休息五分钟，我们再继续整理。
examples.trans: Take a five-minute tea break, and then we will carry on tidying.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng. Read cáng for 'hide'; often followed by 在 + place (藏在走廊里 'hidden in the hallway').

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

examples.text: 小猫藏在桌子下面。
examples.trans: The kitten is hiding under the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mí tuán. Combines 谜 ('riddle/puzzle') + 团 ('ball/cluster'); 解开谜团 means 'to solve a mystery'; measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 两位先生，快提上灯笼——九号房开张了，下一个谜团就在树底下！
examples.trans: Grab the lantern, gentlemen—Room Nine is open, and our next mystery starts right under the tree!

examples.text: 三十年前那首圆舞曲的谜团，今天终于全部解开了。
examples.trans: The mystery of that thirty-year-old waltz has finally been completely solved today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.text: 最想搞掉的就是那个淳于乔。
examples.trans: The one you want to take down most is that Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是那个。
examples.trans: This is 那个.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà shí. Time noun combining 那 ('that') + 时 ('time/period'), equivalent to 那时候.

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 三十年前我刚来小院客栈工作，那时这棵梧桐树还没有现在这么高。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago when I first started working at Courtyard Inn, back then this plane tree was not nearly as tall as it is now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu chuō. Combines 邮 ('post/mail') + 戳 ('stamp/seal'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 快看两个星期前的邮戳！谁会从国外给小院客栈写信呢？
examples.trans: Look at the postmark from two weeks ago! Who would write to Courtyard Inn from abroad?

examples.text: 这张旧明信片上的邮戳虽然有点淡，还能看清是一九九六年的五月。
examples.trans: Although the postmark on this old postcard is a bit faded, you can still make out May 1996.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòng. Describes heavy luggage, heavy tools, or serious matters.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiě. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块铁 ('a piece of iron').

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

related.gloss: a piece of iron (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阳光房 ('a sunroom').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?
